title_zh: SteelAgent：钢材强度预测什么时候能外推，预测区间什么时候失效？
dek: 随机拆分上的高分，回答不了新钢族或新实验室的问题。SteelAgent 用同一组工程问题串起点预测、物理特征消融与区间覆盖；结果应跟着留出单位走，而不是随语言界面输出变成对新材料批次的保证。
scope: AI 全文导读 · 待核验。GPT6.2sol 子代理直接核读固定版本 arXiv HTML，并与同版 PDF 对照；本次不是独立 API 账单任务。已读正文全部章节、三张结果表与表注、行内数学及唯一独立展示式，并静态阅读 arXiv 随附 synthetic_coverage.py。该版本没有独立附录，也没有原图；以原表逐行导读代替配图。未运行作者程序、未独立复现实验，未经过人工审稿。

paragraphs.heading: 预测另一炉熟悉钢，还是预测从未见过的钢？
paragraphs.text: SteelAgent 以成分和热处理为输入，用冶金描述符和表格模型估计材料性能及区间，再由语言模型调用工具并组织解释。本文真正检验的不是对话好不好用，而是在换牌号、换钢族或换测量来源时，原有拉伸强度分数还剩多少参考价值。钢材数字取自 SteelBench 既有评估表的二次分析；另有合成实验，不是新一批钢材实测。

evidence.quote: SteelAgent connects three components. A physics layer derives metallurgical descriptors from composition and heat treatment. A prediction layer supplies model estimates, model comparisons and uncertainty intervals. A language model selects tools and explains their outputs. Matbench and matminer provide benchmarks and feature-processing tools for materials modeling ( Dunn et al., 2020 ; Ward et al., 2018 ) . Coscientist and ChemCrow demonstrate complementary uses of language models to coordinate scientific tools ( Boiko et al., 2023 ; M. Bran et al., 2024 ) .
The steel results are a secondary analysis of the SteelBench evaluation tables ( Volkov et al., 2026a ) . A separate, reproducible synthetic experiment examines group holdout for a ridge model.

paragraphs.heading: 点预测最怕与区间最怕的，未必是同一种留出
paragraphs.text: 梯度提升回归器在随机留出上池化折外 R² 为 0.8591，在过滤后的钢族留出降到 0.1134；但它最大的 RMSE 出现在来源留出。同样，名义 90% 的预测区间在来源留出只覆盖 37.6%。若最终要给从未见过的实验室报一个强度区间，随机表格分数再漂亮，也没有回答这个实验室会被覆盖多少次。

evidence.quote: Table 1 gives the SteelBench point-prediction results for the benchmark’s gradient-boosting regressor (GBR) and CatBoost. Random-split R^{2} exceeded 0.85 for both models. When complete families were held out, GBR fell to 0.1134 and CatBoost to 0.3544. Holding out sources produced the largest RMSE for both models, although the lowest GBR R^{2} occurred under family holdout. RMSE and R^{2} need not order the protocols identically because the spread of observed tensile strengths also changes.
Table 3: Empirical tensile-strength interval coverage at 90% nominal coverage. Width is the mean interval width. Sample counts are specific to this evaluation.
Holdout n Point-model R^{2} Coverage Width (MPa) Random 1,636 0.846 91.0% 378 Grade group 1,636 0.705 83.1% 357 Family 1,357 -0.054 76.1% 385 Source 1,636 0.125 37.6% 412

paragraphs.heading: 划分的单位应当对应部署承诺
paragraphs.text: 同一牌号的不同炉次以及同一来源的测量，在随机切分时可能同时落入训练和测试折。这样的测试可以回答同类记录之间的插值问题，却不能直接证明对新牌号或新来源的外推。作者据此分别留出记录、牌号、钢族和来源；动机是把“未见”的含义从笼统标签变成工程上能复查的实验条件，而不是断言既有工作都存在数据泄漏。

evidence.quote: When an engineer requests a tensile-strength estimate for an alloy, the most relevant test set depends on what is already known about that alloy. Predicting another heat of a familiar grade, predicting an unfamiliar grade, and transferring a model to a new measurement source pose different questions. The distinction matters when the estimate guides alloy selection or prompts an engineer to order a qualification test.

Prior work has used machine learning to predict steel properties, design alloys and organize materials data ( Xiong et al., 2020 ; Wen et al., 2019 ; Choudhary et al., 2022 ) . Train–test overlap and choices about data partitioning can make performance difficult to interpret ( Kapoor and Narayanan, 2023 ) . In a random split, related grades and measurements from the same source may occur on both sides. An evaluation intended to establish transfer across grades or sources must explicitly withhold those units.

Four evaluation protocols probe different forms of transfer. Random k -fold assigns individual records to folds. Group k -fold withholds all records for a grade together. Leave-one-family-out (LOFO) withholds a metallurgical family. Leave-one-source-out (LOSO) withholds a provenance group. These protocols change group composition and sometimes sample size. They do not isolate a unique physical cause of the performance differences.

paragraphs.heading: 在原来人群校准过，不代表换来源还能用
paragraphs.text: 分割式共形预测的边际覆盖依赖校准与测试观测可交换。一个新来源可能有另一套残差分布，此时随机切分上的覆盖率不能视为它的下界。作者用最能暴露这一差距的对照：分别改变留出单位，并把区间宽度和实际覆盖同时列出，由读者检验更宽是否真的弥补了来源差异。

evidence.quote: The benchmark used conformalized quantile regression (CQR) with quantile-loss gradient boosting ( Romano et al., 2019 ) . Split conformal methods provide marginal coverage under exchangeability of calibration and test observations ( Vovk et al., 2005 ; Angelopoulos and Bates, 2023 ) . Holding out an entire source can change the residual distribution, so nominal coverage under exchangeability need not carry over unchanged ( Tibshirani et al., 2019 ) .

Mean widths varied from 357 to 412 MPa while realized coverage ranged from 37.6% to 91.0% (Table 3 ). Under source holdout the shortfall relative to nominal coverage was 52.4 percentage points. For a new source, a wide interval by itself offers little assurance that calibration remains appropriate.

paragraphs.heading: 描述符、预测器和对话接口要能分别审计
paragraphs.text: 物理层从配方和热处理导出马氏体开始转变温度、碳当量和理想临界直径等描述符；预测层提供强度估计、比较模型和不确定性区间；LLM 负责选择工具和解释输出。记录原始配方、计算规则及所得描述符，能将输入缺项或规则错误与语言解释错误分开定位。这里的“物理信息”是输入特征，不是对预测器施加了强度必须服从的硬约束。

evidence.quote: SteelAgent connects three components. A physics layer derives metallurgical descriptors from composition and heat treatment. A prediction layer supplies model estimates, model comparisons and uncertainty intervals. A language model selects tools and explains their outputs. Matbench and matminer provide benchmarks and feature-processing tools for materials modeling ( Dunn et al., 2020 ; Ward et al., 2018 ) . Coscientist and ChemCrow demonstrate complementary uses of language models to coordinate scientific tools ( Boiko et al., 2023 ; M. Bran et al., 2024 ) .

The descriptors include martensite start temperature, carbon equivalent and ideal critical diameter. Their physical interpretation draws on established heat-treatment relations ( Andrews, 1965 ; Grossmann and Bain, 1964 ) . For example, with composition expressed as weight percentages, the carbon equivalent used in the demonstration combines the alloying elements as

A practical implementation must specify how it handles missing elements before evaluating this expression. Recording the composition, the rule used and its output lets an engineer audit a calculation separately from the language model’s interpretation.

paragraphs.heading: 点估计、区间和合规分数是三件事
paragraphs.text: 系统可查参考牌号、预测性能、检查规格并筛选逆向设计候选；基准区间由分位数损失梯度提升结合 CQR 得到。把单炉结果转为过规格的概率，则另外使用对称区间和近似高斯条件误差，并非 CQR 直接给出的概率。实际推断没有待测炉次的真值；实测到达后可以数区间是否命中，但不能把这一步当作此前的估计已获资格认证。

evidence.quote: The demonstration describes six operations: looking up a reference grade, computing physical descriptors, predicting a property, checking a specification, comparing models and screening candidate compositions for inverse design.

The benchmark used conformalized quantile regression (CQR) with quantile-loss gradient boosting ( Romano et al., 2019 ) . Split conformal methods provide marginal coverage under exchangeability of calibration and test observations ( Vovk et al., 2005 ; Angelopoulos and Bates, 2023 ) . Holding out an entire source can change the residual distribution, so nominal coverage under exchangeability need not carry over unchanged ( Tibshirani et al., 2019 ) .
The demonstration offers a separate Gaussian approximation.

The calculation assumes an approximately centered Gaussian conditional error distribution. CQR intervals can be asymmetric, and marginal calibration does not establish that assumption. Validation against observed pass/fail outcomes is needed before using this score for qualification.

paragraphs.heading: 先读原文唯一的独立展示式：IIW 碳当量
paragraphs.text: 同是钢材成分表，哪些元素以多大相对权重进入一个冶金描述量，可以直接由下方原式逐项手算。算式输入是质量百分数而非质量分数，输出仍按同一百分数口径解释。作者特别提醒先明确缺测元素处理；碳当量是特征，不是直接输出 MPa 的抗拉强度式，也不能代替热处理条件。

evidence.quote: The descriptors include martensite start temperature, carbon equivalent and ideal critical diameter. Their physical interpretation draws on established heat-treatment relations ( Andrews, 1965 ; Grossmann and Bain, 1964 ) . For example, with composition expressed as weight percentages, the carbon equivalent used in the demonstration combines the alloying elements as

A practical implementation must specify how it handles missing elements before evaluating this expression. Recording the composition, the rule used and its output lets an engineer audit a calculation separately from the language model’s interpretation.

paragraphs.heading: 池化分数高，不能反驳各族内分数低
paragraphs.text: 全文还在行内定义折外池化决定系数和合规近似。本页不把行内式重新绘制成独立原式。池化评分用所有测试响应的总均值作参照，同一钢族内的分数却以该族均值和较局部的响应变差为分母。跨族差异可以抬高池化分数，即使各族内部排序和数值预测不够好；族内均值在这里是回顾性参照，不是部署时已知的预测。

evidence.quote: The headline outcome is ultimate tensile strength in MPa. We use the reported pooled out-of-fold coefficient of determination, R^{2}=1-\sum_{i}(y_{i}-\hat{y}_{i})^{2}/\sum_{i}(y_{i}-\bar{y})^{2} , and root mean squared error (RMSE). Each prediction in the pooled score comes from a fit that withheld its test fold. A score calculated within one held-out family uses that family’s own response mean and denominator. The pooled score can therefore be positive even when many within-family scores are negative.
A negative score means that the sum of squared errors exceeded the sum obtained by using the held-out group’s mean, a retrospective reference value.

paragraphs.heading: 核心 Silver、扩展 Silver、实验室 Gold 不能互换
paragraphs.text: Silver 核心 1,636 条、594 个牌号，供主要基准；扩展 Silver 2,219 条用于学习曲线和种子敏感性。Gold 库存有 68 炉，牌号留出消融只使用其中对应四牌号的 60 项机械试验。点预测表固定种子 42，核心表的钢族留出为筛选后的 1,351 条，区间表的钢族留出却是 1,357 条；不应把两表的 R² 对齐解释成同一模型同一批样本的前后变化。

evidence.quote: The 1,636-record Silver core spans 594 grades. The SteelBench v1.0 dataset record describes 17 families ( Volkov et al., 2026b ) . A separate extended Silver compilation contains 2,219 records and supplies the learning-curve and seed-sensitivity analyses. The laboratory Gold tier comprises 68 heats, with 60 mechanical tests across four grades used in the grade-holdout ablation
Table 1: Pooled out-of-fold tensile-strength results from the SteelBench evaluation tables (seed 42). RMSE is in MPa. The headline family holdout uses a filtered set of 1,351 records.
Holdout n Point-model R^{2} Coverage Width (MPa) Random 1,636 0.846 91.0% 378 Grade group 1,636 0.705 83.1% 357 Family 1,357 -0.054 76.1% 385 Source 1,636 0.125 37.6% 412

paragraphs.heading: 合成数据另做岭回归，不是钢材 CQR 的重跑
paragraphs.text: 作者用已知生成过程造出有组中心、组截距及非线性项的数据，分别做逐条随机留出、随机留两组和极端组留出，岭回归用分开的校准子集上绝对残差来定对称区间。最后一个情景同时改了响应函数，因此不能把它和第二个情景的差值只归给测试组更极端。已通读官方附带脚本；脚本中的随机设置是单次随机分训练和测试再拆校准集，不是对钢材表进行交叉验证。

evidence.quote: We also tested coverage in a regression problem with a known data-generating process. Each of 1,636 observations belongs to one of twelve groups. The eleven-dimensional covariate vector is the sum of a group center drawn from N(0,4I) and independent N(0,0.64I) noise. The response combines a linear term, an interaction, a squared feature, a random group intercept and independent Gaussian noise. We fit ridge regression with penalty one and calibrate symmetric intervals on absolute residuals from a separate calibration set.

In the second, we held out two randomly selected groups. In the third, we held out two groups chosen by the group-center projection rule in the script and added a nonlinear term to the response function for that setting. Mean empirical coverage (standard deviation across seeds) was 90.6% (2.0 percentage points), 54.3% (28.5 points) and 52.1% (23.8 points), respectively. The last setting changes the response function as well as the choice of test groups, so the difference from the second setting cannot be attributed to group selection alone.

paragraphs.heading: 哪些结果可以重新算，哪些只能核对已发表表格
paragraphs.text: 作者指向公开 SteelBench 数据子集和合成实验脚本，但受限来源和历史逐炉预测不随本版本发布。已读取的来源未说明足以重建历史训练的全部超参数、统一算力或每个模型的耗时预算；本文也没有用同一逐炉预测记录重新计算模型差异的区间。应先取得匹配的折号、目标值和预测，再做按来源或钢族重抽样，不宜从汇总表推回逐炉误差。

evidence.quote: The point-prediction, feature-ablation and coverage tables are attributed to the SteelBench benchmark manuscript ( Volkov et al., 2026a ) . Restricted source measurements and historical per-heat prediction logs are outside the scope of this release.
Original per-heat predictions would be needed to recompute uncertainty in the steel metrics or to compare models on identical held-out units.

paragraphs.heading: 先读原表 1：两种误差量不一定把行排成同一顺序
paragraphs.text: 沿 GBR 列由随机行走到钢族行，R² 从 0.8591 到 0.1134；再看来源行，R² 回到 0.1691，RMSE 却从钢族的 218.3 MPa 升到 277.0 MPa。RMSE 按绝对强度误差计，R² 还受测试响应跨度影响。另看分组统计，CatBoost 在十二个已报告钢族中有八个族内 R² 为负；整体池化仍为正，不能外推为“大多数族预测准确”。

evidence.quote: Table 1: Pooled out-of-fold tensile-strength results from the SteelBench evaluation tables (seed 42). RMSE is in MPa. The headline family holdout uses a filtered set of 1,351 records.

Holding out sources produced the largest RMSE for both models, although the lowest GBR R^{2} occurred under family holdout. RMSE and R^{2} need not order the protocols identically because the spread of observed tensile strengths also changes.
CatBoost produced a negative within-family R^{2} in eight of the twelve reported families, including low-carbon steel ( -2.925 ) and the remaining low-alloy group ( -0.018 ).

paragraphs.heading: 原表 2 要横着读，换模型或换留出时增益会反号
paragraphs.text: 在全 17 钢族 Silver 的同一行，GBR 增加描述符后池化 R² 由 −0.0336 到 0.2198，变化 +0.2534；同条件 CatBoost 的变化为 −0.1353。Gold 留牌号的 GBR 却变化 −0.358，而 Ridge 由 −2.042 到 0.199。Silver 与 Gold 的描述符集合、样本、人群和留出单位均不等，不能据两个 GBR 方向相反便归因为某条冶金关系失效；仍需逐模型、逐场景做消融。

evidence.quote: The demonstration reported an increase of about 0.25 in family-holdout GBR R^{2} . The full-family ablation supports that result: adding descriptors moved R^{2} from -0.0336 to 0.2198, an increase of 0.2534 (Table 2 ). This experiment included all 17 families, without the minimum-family-size filter used for the headline family result in Table 1 . CatBoost’s score declined in the same ablation.
Table 2: Tensile-strength ablations from SteelBench. Changes are differences in pooled R^{2} within each row. The Silver and Gold tests use different holdout units and descriptor sets.

Population and holdout Model Baseline Augmented Change Silver, family GBR -0.0336 0.2198 +0.2534 Silver, family CatBoost 0.2400 0.1047 -0.1353 Gold, grade Ridge -2.042 0.199 +2.241 Gold, grade GBR -1.385 -1.743 -0.358 Gold, grade CatBoost -1.316 -1.255 +0.061

paragraphs.heading: 原表 3 先对比分母，再看区间加宽仍覆盖不足
paragraphs.text: 名义 90% 的 CQR 区间，在随机、牌号、钢族和来源留出的实测覆盖分别为 91.0%、83.1%、76.1%、37.6%；来源留出的平均全宽为 412 MPa，随机留出为 378 MPa。总体上覆盖变差并非区间越来越窄。覆盖是该批测试样本实际落入区间的比例，不是某炉超过规格的概率，更不是每个来源各自达到该比例。

evidence.quote: Table 3: Empirical tensile-strength interval coverage at 90% nominal coverage. Width is the mean interval width. Sample counts are specific to this evaluation.
Holdout n Point-model R^{2} Coverage Width (MPa) Random 1,636 0.846 91.0% 378 Grade group 1,636 0.705 83.1% 357 Family 1,357 -0.054 76.1% 385 Source 1,636 0.125 37.6% 412
A nominal 90% CQR interval does not identify the conditional probability that a particular heat exceeds a specification minimum y_{\min} .

paragraphs.heading: 合成实验显露跨组不稳定，但不是所有偏移都会欠覆盖
paragraphs.text: 三种合成情景按种子平均覆盖为 90.6%、54.3% 和 52.1%，种子间标准差分别为 2.0、28.5、23.8 个百分点。后两组的离散程度很大，不宜用单个平均值给出对固定未来组的覆盖承诺。反过来，如果预测器的绝对误差随输入移动却保持不变，纯输入分布变化也未必降低覆盖。钢材表展示的是具体来源失配而非普遍定律。

evidence.quote: In the second, we held out two randomly selected groups. In the third, we held out two groups chosen by the group-center projection rule in the script and added a nonlinear term to the response function for that setting. Mean empirical coverage (standard deviation across seeds) was 90.6% (2.0 percentage points), 54.3% (28.5 points) and 52.1% (23.8 points), respectively. The last setting changes the response function as well as the choice of test groups, so the difference from the second setting cannot be attributed to group selection alone.

This construction illustrates one way coverage can deteriorate. A change in the input distribution alone does not imply undercoverage. For example, if a fixed predictor has an absolute error of one for every input, a calibrated interval with half-width one continues to cover even when the input distribution moves to an entirely different region. The experiment supplements the benchmark evidence without establishing a universal relation between group shift and coverage.

paragraphs.heading: 报告范围：覆盖报警、资质合规和 LLM 的证据等级不同
paragraphs.text: 作者把 85% 滚动覆盖阈值视为供调查的例子，表中没有给出它的误报率，单靠覆盖也不能辨认偏移成因。所选钢材定量比较限于抗拉强度，虽然演示涉及屈服性能。合规分数没有前瞻资格鉴定验证，语言界面也没有专家用户研究；不能把界面可运行或对话能解释数字当作合规能力、泛化或决策可靠性证据。

evidence.quote: Once measured outcomes arrive, a rolling coverage estimate can flag a shortfall for investigation. An 85% trigger is one possible operational threshold. These tables do not establish its false-alarm rate or identify the type of shift from coverage alone.

The system demonstrations cover tensile and yield properties. The quantitative comparisons here concern tensile strength. We have not validated the compliance score in prospective alloy qualification or assessed the language-model interface in an expert-user study.

paragraphs.heading: 本站追问：学习曲线差距有多少是样本量不等？
paragraphs.text: 两个协议在同名训练比例下不必有相同记录数。建议在同一组可比训练样本量和同一外层留出上形成学习曲线，区分多给同一种钢的炉次与多给一种来源的贡献；同时分开报按炉次池化和对族等权的结果。这样的实验不会消除所有群组构成差异，但能排除一部分“多看了数据才分数更高”的解释。

evidence.quote: The nominal fractions corresponded to different numbers of records under the two protocols; at 100%, the tabulated counts were 2,219 and 1,209, respectively. The gap persisted over the measured settings. These results do not establish how it would behave with a larger matched training set.

paragraphs.heading: 迁移到 TEC 预报：换台站、换来源、换风暴三张考卷
paragraphs.text: 在固定发布时刻和统一预报时效下，以随机时段、整站、整场地磁事件、整产品来源分别作外层测试；模型训练和校准分开，禁止相邻重叠时间窗或同一事件跨折。给同一预测器有无物理特征做成配对消融，交付分时效 TECU 误差、按事件或台站等权覆盖率与宽度。与留出天气事件一起报告校准来源，避免把随机折覆盖当作跨风暴保障。

paragraphs.heading: 把覆盖报警预先注册成有代价的监控实验
paragraphs.text: 对能拿到独立 GNSS 参考的延迟预报，先在开发期选定滚动窗、数据缺报规则和报警线，再在未来留出期模拟产品切换或接收机变更。按连续时段分块估计误报、检测延迟和报警后区间加宽带来的额外成本，另报失锁率等独立观测量作为诊断线索。先证明覆盖变化能触发有效排查；不要把 TEC 或延迟区间直接称为定位保护级。

equations.title: IIW 碳当量：把多个合金元素组合成描述符
equations.meaning: 各项以输入表中的质量百分数代入。教学算例（非论文数据）：若 C 为 0.20%、Mn 为 0.60%、Cr 为 0.50%，其余所列元素已知为零，则三个贡献分别为 0.20、0.60 除以 6 得 0.10，以及 0.50 除以 5 得 0.10，总计 0.40%。
equations.caution: 缺测不等于零；算例只把已知为零的项填零。若原数据给 0–1 质量分数，先统一换算。此式没有热处理项，也不表示抗拉强度或是否达标。

symbols.text: 单炉的标量碳当量；随输入沿用质量百分数口径。
铬、钼、钒的质量百分数，先求和再除以原式权重系数。
镍、铜的质量百分数；另一组独立权重。
